independentSession: Fresh detached Linux checkout in DkCompany-Test WSL2, Ubuntu 24.04, uid 1000 dkcverify, linux-x64, Node v22.22.3, npm 10.9.8. The candidate checkout was clean before and after verification; the evidence worktree is separate.
summary: Exact source passed install, historical assembly, validate, the full root test target (528/528), 42 approval tests, 3 approval restart tests, 5 curriculum tests, and seven independent HTTP/in-process adversarial probes. The maintained R1-R4 probe confirms R1, R2, and R4 behavior. A same-tenant null-requester withdrawal flaw found on failed candidate 3ea8ee4 was fixed on 1ec0b96 and the reproducer passes. Two persistence runtime-job failures also occur on pre-S1-03 base 7bd3626 and are recorded as inherited; the candidate persistence suite is 78/80.

findings: Full make test stopped in runtime test utilgængelig approval-service stopper A3: createApprovalClient required an HTTP workload Bearer token absent from the test fixture (119 passed, 1 failed). The fixture was repaired in the follow-up source commit.

Independent adversarial probes passed 6/7. An unrelated same-tenant human could withdraw a server-created request with requestedBy=null, changing state pending to withdrawn. Fixed and retested on 1ec0b96.
